supporting_observations.claim: On FILE-MAP-01, Safeharbor's approved backup agent started under svc-vault with a Nightly job targeting ingest.safeharbor-backup.net.
The agent connected to the explicit proxy, and the proxy recorded a successful tunnel to the approved Safeharbor endpoint carrying 640,000,000 client-to-server bytes.
Zeek recorded approximately 640 MB from FILE-MAP-01 to the proxy on that connection, consistent with the large transfer described in the alert and the inventory's expected Safeharbor backup uploads.
The transfer is logged at about 13:51 UTC, several minutes later than the alert's approximate 13:46 time.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection from WS-GLUND-01 was unavailable from 13:25 to 14:00 UTC; this limits investigation of that workstation's activity but does not remove the FILE-MAP-01 and proxy records for the transfer.
The proxy tunnel records establish destination and byte volume, but the available records do not expose the contents of the encrypted upload.
claims_not_established: The precise contents of the uploaded data and whether the backup completed successfully are not established by these records.
The evidence does not establish why the alert timestamp is approximately 13:46 when the correlated high-volume transfer is logged around 13:51 UTC.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: greta.lund logged into FILE-MAP-01 over RDP from WS-GLUND-01, although the environment context says remote administration is done only from WS-AHASSAN-01; the workstation's Winsec and Sysmon collection has an outage during this period. Records: T170-00241, T170-00244, T170-00245.
Separate ticket: PROXY-MAP-01 attempted an RDP connection to FILE-MAP-01 using the disabled svc_mgmt account, which failed. Records: T170-00494, T170-00496, T170-00497.

Separate ticket: an unapproved Meridian OpsAgent executable ran on FILE-MAP-01 and attempted explicit authentication as svc-vault to DC-MAP-01. Records: T170-00542, T170-00544, T170-00545, T170-00546.
